dogecoin.text:
Why is this huge?

🔹 Dogecoin can now be used in DeFi, DApps, and smart contracts on ICP
🔹 No need for centralized bridges. Pure trustless Dogecoin.
🔹 Super cheap & fast transactions compared to the Dogecoin network

Enter ckDOGE. ckDOGE is a 1:1 twin token for Dogecoin on ICP.

It offers:
✅ Fast transactions ⚡
✅ Low fees 💰
✅ Seamless smart contract integration via ICRC token standards

What does this enable? 🤔

With ICP’s threshold ECDSA signing, smart contracts (canisters) can now hold & transfer native Dogecoin—no bridges, no intermediaries, just pure decentralization.

Native Dogecoin Integration 🐶

ICP replicas will now follow the Dogecoin network and store its UTXO set in a special Dogecoin canister. This means ICP can read Dogecoin’s state natively & securely!

ICP 🤝 $DOGE

ICP welcomes the integration of @dogecoin through Meridian milestone. With this milestone, chain fusion is integrating native Dogecoin.

This enables secure on-chain transactions & a new token: ckDOGE. Here’s what you need to know! 👇 https://t.co/EthDSrfsou
